description: Sends a booking enquiry for a beach club in the United Arab Emirates to the BeachClubs.ae team, who reply to the guest by email. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking. Requires the guest's name, email, visit date, number of guests and acceptance of the BeachClubs.ae terms of service and privacy policy.

agreed_to_terms.description: Must be true: the guest accepts the BeachClubs.ae terms of service and privacy policy.

club_name.description: Beach club name, used when no club_id is given. Typo tolerant.

email.description: Guest's email address; the BeachClubs.ae team replies here.

message.description: Optional message, up to 1000 characters (for example seating preference or occasion).

visit_date.description: Planned visit date, YYYY-MM-DD, today (Dubai time) or later.

name: request_booking_enquiry
title: Request a booking enquiry
